items.title: Pluggable CLI harnesses
items.text: Run Antigravity (agy) by default, or switch to OpenCode, Pi, Claude Code, or Custom ACP.

items.title: Keyless local voice
items.text: Offline speech with Kokoro and Piper, plus free Edge TTS with Moroccan Arabic ar-MA.

items.title: Cross-platform Gemini Live
items.text: Real-time Gemini Live voice now works on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

items.title: Auto-detected onboarding
items.text: Setup scans your PATH for ready harnesses and skips API keys in Classic Mode.

items.title: Bilingual RTL support
items.text: Arabic and right-to-left text format cleanly across chats, notes, and inputs.

items.title: Direct keys and Fish Audio
items.text: Replaced legacy direct provider keys and Fish Audio with CLI harnesses and local TTS.
